idea-plugin.name: Phantom File Icons
idea-plugin.description: Colored file and folder icons by name and extension, drawn from the Material Icon Theme by Philipp Kief (MIT). Java files and classes show Material icons by kind (class, abstract class, interface, enum, record, annotation, exception); Kotlin files show the Kotlin logo; source, test and resource roots get their own folder colors. Only the icons of files on screen are loaded. Turn the plugin off to get the platform icons back.
